description.en: Ping Wang is an undergraduate researcher at the University of Washington working on post-training and evaluation of generative models and multimodal learning, with music and audio as a main testbed. Advised by Prof. Noah A. Smith (UW) and Prof. Yi-Hsuan Yang (NTU).
description.zh: 王平是華盛頓大學的大學部學生研究員，研究生成模型的後訓練與評估以及多模態學習，並以音樂與音訊作為主要的實驗場域，由 Noah A. Smith 教授（華盛頓大學）與楊奕軒教授（臺灣大學）指導。

home.en:
I am an undergraduate in the [Paul G. Allen School of Computer Science & Engineering](https://www.cs.washington.edu/) at the University of Washington, where I am advised by Prof. [Noah A. Smith](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~nasmith/) in [Noah’s ARK](https://noahs-ark.github.io/). Since May 2026, I have also been a student researcher in the [Music and AI Lab](https://affige.github.io/lab.html) at National Taiwan University, advised by Prof. [Yi-Hsuan Yang](https://affige.github.io/).

My research focuses on post-training and evaluating generative models: how to design reward signals that capture what people actually value, how to optimize models against them with preference optimization and reinforcement learning, and how to check that automatic evaluation agrees with human judgment. I study these questions in multimodal settings, with music and audio as my main testbed. My recent work uses audio-language models as [rubric-based judges](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03589) to post-train text-to-music models, and [validates evaluation metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04511) for music transcription against a listening study with over 100 participants.

More broadly, I'm interested in reward design, model-based evaluation (LLM and audio-language-model judges), and multimodal learning, as well as music information retrieval and symbolic music modeling.

I'm always happy to chat about research, music, or possible collaborations. The best way to reach me is by email at [pingw220@gmail.com](mailto:pingw220@gmail.com).
home.zh:
我是華盛頓大學 [Paul G. Allen 電腦科學與工程學院](https://www.cs.washington.edu/)的大學部學生，在 [Noah’s ARK](https://noahs-ark.github.io/) 由 [Noah A. Smith](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~nasmith/) 教授指導。自 2026 年 5 月起，我也在臺灣大學 [Music and AI Lab](https://affige.github.io/lab.html) 擔任學生研究員，由[楊奕軒](https://affige.github.io/)教授指導。

我的研究聚焦於生成模型的後訓練與評估：如何設計能反映人們真正在意之處的獎勵訊號、如何用偏好最佳化與強化學習對模型進行最佳化，以及如何確認自動評估與人類判斷一致。我在多模態情境中研究這些問題，並以音樂與音訊作為主要的實驗場域。近期的研究以音訊語言模型作為[依評分標準（rubric）打分的評審](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.03589)，對文字生成音樂模型進行後訓練；並透過超過 100 位受試者的聽測實驗，[驗證自動採譜的評估指標](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.04511)。

更廣泛來說，我對獎勵設計、以模型作為評審的評估方法（LLM 與音訊語言模型評審）以及多模態學習都有興趣，也喜歡音樂資訊檢索與符號音樂建模。

歡迎找我聊研究、音樂或合作機會。最好的聯絡方式是寄信到 [pingw220@gmail.com](mailto:pingw220@gmail.com)。

about.en:
I'm Ping Wang (王平), an undergraduate studying computer science at the [Paul G. Allen School](https://www.cs.washington.edu/), University of Washington. I work with Prof. [Noah A. Smith](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~nasmith/) at UW and, since May 2026, with Prof. [Yi-Hsuan Yang](https://affige.github.io/) in the [Music and AI Lab](https://affige.github.io/lab.html) at National Taiwan University.

My research is about post-training and evaluating generative models: designing reward signals, optimizing models with preference optimization and reinforcement learning, and making sure automatic evaluation agrees with people. Music and audio are where I test these ideas. I post-train text-to-music models with rubric-based rewards from audio-language models, and I study how to evaluate music transcription so that scores reflect how people actually read and hear the results. I also build open-source tools such as [SheetSage-Pro](/projects/sheetsage-pro), a song-to-lead-sheet pipeline.
about.zh:
我是王平（Ping Wang），在華盛頓大學 [Paul G. Allen 電腦科學與工程學院](https://www.cs.washington.edu/)就讀資訊工程。我在華盛頓大學與 [Noah A. Smith](https://homes.cs.washington.edu/~nasmith/) 教授一起做研究，並自 2026 年 5 月起，在臺灣大學 [Music and AI Lab](https://affige.github.io/lab.html) 與[楊奕軒](https://affige.github.io/)教授一起研究。

我的研究關注生成模型的後訓練與評估：設計獎勵訊號、用偏好最佳化與強化學習對模型進行最佳化，並確保自動評估與人的判斷一致。音樂與音訊是我驗證這些想法的場域：我用音訊語言模型依評分標準（rubric）給出的獎勵對文字生成音樂模型進行後訓練，也研究如何評估自動採譜，讓分數反映人們實際如何閱讀與聆聽結果。我也開發開源工具，例如把歌曲轉成主旋律譜的 [SheetSage-Pro](/projects/sheetsage-pro)。
